summary: Signal period robust (12 epochs incl. a 2nd S7 transit the paper missed; new-data dchi2=594; odd/even 1.5 sig; no secondary). Difference images in 5 sectors (S7,S33,S44,S46,S71; different orientations) put the source 15-19 arcsec from the target (6-10 sig), within 0.1 px of Gaia DR3 3163160576472073216 (G=17.2, 16 arcsec; would need ~48% eclipse). Validation controls TOI-5542/TOI-2589 locate on-target within 1-3 arcsec. Tension: TESS-SPOC mom_centr shows no significant shift. Period is that of the contaminating signal, not a planet on the target.

Signal period robust (9 epochs, 3 consecutive in S61-62; new-data dchi2=1087). Depth depends on aperture (QLP 1.14 vs SPOC 0.6-1.3), SPOC centroid shift 5.3/3.6 sig. Difference images in S8, S35 (discovery transits), S62, S99 put the source 13-18 arcsec from target (7-11 sig), within 0.1-0.3 px of Gaia DR3 5653790567866817152 (G=14.07, 18 arcsec; needs ~2.5% eclipse). S89 difference image dominated by pointing systematics (dipoles on all bright stars), not used.

Diff images: source 13-20 arcsec from target at 7-10 sig in S10,S37,S64,S90,S100 (S63 inconclusive). Also in-transit centroid shift 20/8 sig, depth varies by product, one shallow S63 epoch, odd/even 6.9 sig. G=12.5 star at 19 arcsec would need a 1.5% eclipse.

Diff images: source 41-63 arcsec from target at 16-28 sig in S1,S67,S94,S95 (S27 3 sig, S103 5 sig). Candidate source: G=11.5 star at 57.5 arcsec. Not related to catalog star TIC 265465927 (1.5 deg away).

TOI-6559. Period robust (2 consecutive SPOC transits S100/S101); depths consistent; odd/even 0.8 sig; secondary 0.16+/-0.07 ppt. Diff images consistent with target or the Gaia DR3 companion 5868362254940876672 (G=14.12, dG=3.6, 1.65 arcsec, PA 36 deg; would need ~10% eclipse). Gemini/Zorro speckle (2025-03-12, ExoFOP) covers only +/-1.27 arcsec; calibrated contrast curve stops at 1.2 arcsec. Needs seeing-limited ground photometry resolving 1.65 arcsec.

Diff images on target in all 6 sectors (0.6-2.6 arcsec, <=2 sig). Depth 15.6 ppt, T14 2.1 h; product depth differences consistent with crowding correction; QLP-only odd/even consistent; no secondary; no centroid shift. Caveat: Gaia DR3 SB1 orbit 7.545 d, K~4.8 km/s (host is a binary).
Diff images on target in S34, S99; S88 6 arcsec at 3.4 sig (borderline); S8 too noisy. Depths consistent (chi2 9.3/3), odd/even 1.1 sig. Caveats: grazing (b~0.95), secondary 1.0+/-0.5 ppt (2 sig).

Diff images on target in S9, S36, S45 (<=1.6 sig); S46 4.8 arcsec at 5 sig (near method floor). 17 ppt, b~0; depth chi2 38.7/3 (one shallow epoch), odd/even 3.8 sig mixed; secondary 0.5+/-0.24 ppt; 2 epochs near momentum dumps.

Diff images on target in S5, S97, S98 (<=1.4 sig); S32 4.9 arcsec at 4.1 sig. New transits only in S97/S98 QLP (problematic sectors) but diff images there are on-target at SNR ~10. QLP vs TESS-SPOC depth difference consistent with crowding; odd/even 0.2 sig; no secondary.
